id: 08_Titration of Strong Acid With Strong Base
title: 强酸强碱滴定（国内版）
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/08_Titration of Strong Acid With Strong Base.md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/08_Titration of Strong Acid With Strong Base（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 强酸强碱：等当点呈中性
points.K11: 滴定管装碱，锥形瓶装酸
points.K14: 装碱戴好护目镜和手套
points.K20: 半毫升到一滴，摇匀看色
points.S1: 灌装不过头顶，不站凳子
points.S3: 稀释浓酸：通风柜、酸入水
points.S6: 溅到人身上：冲洗与报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在滴定装置旁，锥形瓶里是浅粉红溶液，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a burette on a ring stand with a flask of pale pink solution below and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来做强酸强碱滴定。

shots.scene: 滴定管、锥形瓶、指示剂滴瓶、计算器四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a burette, an Erlenmeyer flask, a small dropper bottle and a calculator. No people.
shots.narration: 装好、读准、滴准、算准。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在凳子上，举着瓶子往高高的滴定管里倒液体
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on a stool and lifts a bottle above his head to pour liquid into a tall burette.
shots.narration: 阿杰站上凳子，举着碱液往上倒。

shots.scene: 小研赶紧扶住凳子，示意他下来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over, steadies the stool and signals him to step down.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧叫停：太危险了！

shots.scene: 小研把滴定管从夹上取下，放低到胸前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the burette in its clamp to chest height below eye level.
shots.narration: 把滴定管放低，在视线以下灌装。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 滴定要准，更要安全。

shots.scene: 酸和碱两个图标，中间一个滴定管图标
shots.prompt_en: An acid bottle icon and a base bottle icon with a burette icon between them. No people.
shots.narration: 先回顾一下酸碱和滴定。

shots.scene: 滴定管标已知、锥形瓶标未知的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A titration diagram: a burette marked with a green check above, and a flask marked with a question mark below. No people.
shots.narration: 滴定是中和反应，用已知测未知。

shots.scene: 体积、物质的量、浓度三个图标用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by arrows: a volume scale, a pile of particles, and a concentration dial. No people.
shots.narration: 由滴定剂用了多少，算出未知浓度。

shots.scene: 一个酸分子和一个碱分子相遇，生成盐和水
shots.prompt_en: One acid particle icon meets one base particle icon and they turn into a salt crystal icon and a water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 盐酸和氢氧化钠，一比一反应。

shots.scene: 天平两边分别是酸和碱的小球，数量相等
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with equal numbers of acid balls and base balls on each side. No people.
shots.narration: 加了多少碱，就知道原来有多少酸。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶里酸和碱的小球正好配对完
shots.prompt_en: Inside a flask, every acid ball pairs with a base ball, leaving only salt and water icons. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碱恰好中和的点，叫等当点。

shots.scene: 滴定管尖一滴一滴落下
shots.prompt_en: Single drops fall slowly from the burette tip into the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 要一点一点慢慢加，才能停在这里。

shots.scene: 计算器图标淡出，手和滴定管图标放大
shots.prompt_en: A calculator icon fades back while a hand turning a burette stopcock icon comes forward. No people.
shots.narration: 计算课上讲过，这里重点练动手。

shots.section_title: 强酸强碱：等当点呈中性
shots.scene: pH 刻度条上指针停在中间
shots.prompt_en: A pH color scale bar with a pointer stopping exactly in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 强酸强碱恰好中和，溶液呈中性。
overlay: 强酸强碱：等当点呈中性

shots.section_title: 强酸强碱：等当点呈中性
shots.scene: 盐和水两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A salt crystal icon and a water drop icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 只剩盐和水，可以测pH判断。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一只小滴瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small brown dropper bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 实验室里，更常用的是指示剂。

shots.scene: 无色溶液在终点变色的示意
shots.prompt_en: A flask icon whose clear liquid suddenly changes color, with a star burst. No people.
shots.narration: 到了等当点，它会变颜色。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶从无色变成粉红
shots.prompt_en: A flask of clear solution turns bright pink. No people.
shots.narration: 常用酚酞：酸性无色，碱性变粉红。

shots.scene: 酸小球用完，多出的碱小球与指示剂小球结合变粉
shots.prompt_en: All acid balls are gone; one extra base ball meets an indicator ball, which turns pink. No people.
shots.narration: 酸一用完，多出的碱就让酚酞变色。

shots.scene: 粉红溶液旁一个计时图标
shots.prompt_en: A flask of pink solution next to a clock icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 粉红一直不褪，就是到了终点。

shots.scene: 四步流程图标：酸加指示剂、碱滴定、变色、计算
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons with arrows: a flask with a drop, a burette dripping, a pink flask, and a calculator. No people.
shots.narration: 酸加指示剂，用碱滴，变色再计算。

shots.scene: 碱液瓶和一瓶未知酸
shots.prompt_en: A plastic base bottle and a glass acid bottle with a question mark, both with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 这次用已知浓度的碱，测盐酸浓度。

shots.scene: 小研站在铁架台后，台上摆好器材
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, goggles and gloves stands behind a ring stand with a burette clamp and laid out equipment.
shots.narration: 先把器材备齐。

shots.scene: 滴定管、锥形瓶、烧杯、漏斗特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a burette, an Erlenmeyer flask, a small beaker and a glass funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 滴定管、锥形瓶、烧杯、漏斗。

shots.scene: 酸瓶、碱瓶、指示剂瓶、量筒特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an acid bottle, a base bottle, an indicator dropper bottle and a graduated cylinder, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 酸、碱、指示剂，还有量筒。

shots.section_title: 滴定管装碱，锥形瓶装酸
shots.scene: 小研把洁净的滴定管夹到滴定管夹上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clamps a clean burette into the burette clamp on the ring stand.
shots.narration: 洁净的滴定管夹在铁架台上。
overlay: 滴定管装碱，锥形瓶装酸

shots.section_title: 滴定管装碱，锥形瓶装酸
shots.scene: 示意：滴定管里是碱，锥形瓶里是酸
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the burette holds the base titrant and the flask below holds the acid analyte. No people.
shots.narration: 管里装碱，下面锥形瓶里装酸。

shots.scene: 小研把滴定管放低，经漏斗加入清水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, with the burette lowered below eye level, pours plain water in through a small funnel.
shots.narration: 装碱之前，先用清水试一试。

shots.scene: 旋塞处渗出水珠的图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up icon of a stopcock with a small water drop leaking out and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 旋塞可能漏液。

shots.scene: 碱液漏出、数字出错的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of base leaking from the stopcock next to a wrong result icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 碱漏掉了，结果就算错了。

shots.scene: 旋塞转到与管平行，水流顺畅流下
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock handle turns parallel to the burette and water flows freely out of the tip. No people.
shots.narration: 不漏了，打开旋塞，看出水是否顺畅。

shots.scene: 小研放空清水，关上旋塞
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drains all the water into a beaker and closes the stopcock.
shots.narration: 确认通畅，放掉清水，关好旋塞。

shots.section_title: 装碱戴好护目镜和手套
shots.scene: 欣欣举着腐蚀性物质警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a corrosive substance warning sign.
shots.narration: 酸和碱都有腐蚀性。
overlay: 装碱戴好护目镜和手套

shots.section_title: 装碱戴好护目镜和手套
shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜和手套，在视线以下经漏斗倒入碱液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, pours base from a small beaker through a funnel into the lowered burette below eye level.
shots.narration: 戴好护目镜手套，经漏斗慢慢灌碱。

shots.section_title: 装碱戴好护目镜和手套
shots.scene: 小研用少量碱液润洗滴定管后放出
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the burette with a small amount of base, tilts and turns it, then drains it into a waste beaker.
shots.narration: 先用少量碱液润洗，再正式装满。

shots.section_title: 装碱戴好护目镜和手套
shots.scene: 滴定管尖嘴里的气泡被排出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the burette tip: a small air bubble is flushed out as liquid runs through. No people.
shots.narration: 放出一点，排掉尖嘴里的气泡。

shots.scene: 眼睛与弯月面最低点平齐的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an eye level with the bottom of the meniscus in a burette, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 平视弯月面最低点读数。

shots.scene: 小研在空白记录本上写下读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes the starting reading in a blank lab notebook.
shots.narration: 按合适的有效数字，记进记录本。

shots.scene: 小研平视量筒量取酸液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student measures acid in a graduated cylinder, checking the level at eye level.
shots.narration: 量取一定体积的待测盐酸。

shots.scene: 酸倒进锥形瓶，放到滴定管正下方
shots.prompt_en: The acid is poured into an Erlenmeyer flask, which is placed right under the burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 倒进锥形瓶，放在滴定管正下方。

shots.scene: 滴瓶向锥形瓶滴入几滴指示剂
shots.prompt_en: A dropper bottle adds a few drops of indicator into the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 再滴几滴指示剂。

shots.scene: 小研一手开旋塞，一手摇锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the stopcock with one hand and swirls the flask with the other.
shots.narration: 先做一次粗滴，快速摸个底。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶放在磁力搅拌器上转动
shots.prompt_en: The flask sits on a magnetic stirrer with a stir bar spinning. No people.
shots.narration: 边滴边摇，也可以用磁力搅拌。

shots.scene: 小研不时停下，观察颜色
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pauses and looks at the flask color closely.
shots.narration: 不时停下，看颜色是否持久变化。

shots.scene: 粗滴数据被灰色划掉标注
shots.prompt_en: A blank data row grayed out with a small rough sketch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 粗滴快但不准，数据不算进结果。

shots.scene: 小研记录终读数，两个读数相减
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes the final reading; a subtraction icon appears between two blank numbers.
shots.narration: 记终读数，减去初读数，就是用量。

shots.scene: 刻度条上的标记略微超过终点
shots.prompt_en: A scale bar with a mark slightly past a dashed target line. No people.
shots.narration: 滴得快，多半加过了一点。

shots.scene: 小研换一瓶新的酸液，重新滴定
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a fresh flask of acid with indicator under the burette.
shots.narration: 再做精滴，这次要准。

shots.scene: 刻度条上四分之三处的标记
shots.prompt_en: A scale bar filled quickly up to a three quarter mark, with the rest dashed. No people.
shots.narration: 先较快加到粗滴用量的四分之三。

shots.scene: 慢行图标出现在剩余的四分之一
shots.prompt_en: A slow snail icon appears over the remaining dashed quarter of the scale bar. No people.
shots.narration: 剩下的，就要放慢了。

shots.section_title: 半毫升到一滴，摇匀看色
shots.scene: 小研轻转旋塞，每次加一小份
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently turns the stopcock to add a small portion, then closes it.
shots.narration: 每次约半毫升，也可以一滴一滴。
overlay: 半毫升到一滴，摇匀看色

shots.section_title: 半毫升到一滴，摇匀看色
shots.scene: 滴入处一闪粉红，摇匀后又褪去
shots.prompt_en: A pink flash appears where a drop lands, then fades as the flask is swirled. No people.
shots.narration: 滴入时一闪粉红，摇匀又没了。

shots.section_title: 半毫升到一滴，摇匀看色
shots.scene: 还没到终点的提示图标
shots.prompt_en: A flask with clear liquid and a small not-yet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这说明还没到终点。

shots.section_title: 半毫升到一滴，摇匀看色
shots.scene: 摇匀后颜色仍保持的锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A swirled flask that stays pale pink, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要等摇匀后，颜色还保持住。

shots.scene: 小研半开旋塞，一滴悬在尖嘴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully lets a single drop hang at the burette tip.
shots.narration: 越接近终点，越要小心。

shots.scene: 深粉红的锥形瓶被打叉，浅粉红的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two flasks: a deep magenta one crossed out with a red X and a pale pink one with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 加过量就错过了终点。

shots.scene: 浅粉红不再变化的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of pale pink solution that stays the same color while swirling. No people.
shots.narration: 浅粉红不再褪去，就是终点。

shots.scene: 小研读终读数，写进记录本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the final burette level at eye level and records it.
shots.narration: 记下终读数，求出用了多少碱。

shots.scene: 公式图示：碱的体积乘浓度除以酸的体积
shots.prompt_en: A simple fraction diagram: a burette volume icon times a concentration icon over a flask volume icon equals a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 碱的体积乘浓度，除以酸的体积。

shots.scene: 三只粉红锥形瓶排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Three pale pink flasks in a row, each with a blank result card. No people.
shots.narration: 一般平行滴定三次。

shots.scene: 三个数合成一个平均值
shots.prompt_en: Three blank number cards merge into one with an average symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 取平均值，结果更可靠。

shots.scene: 弱酸弱碱图标让 pH 指针偏离中间
shots.prompt_en: A weak acid icon and a weak base icon push a pH pointer away from the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 换成弱酸弱碱，终点pH就变了。

shots.scene: 几种不同颜色的指示剂滴瓶
shots.prompt_en: Several indicator dropper bottles with different colored liquids and blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 指示剂也要跟着换。

shots.scene: 电子转移箭头的滴定图标
shots.prompt_en: A titration icon with an electron transfer arrow above the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 还有氧化还原滴定等别的类型。

shots.scene: 小研在滴定管前完成一次滴定，锥形瓶浅粉红
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finishes a titration at the burette; the flask below is pale pink.
shots.narration: 这些是滴定最基本的功夫。

shots.section_title: 灌装不过头顶，不站凳子
shots.scene: 举瓶过头往高处倒液、站在凳子上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing on a stool pouring liquid above head height, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要站凳子，不要举过头顶倒液。
overlay: 灌装不过头顶，不站凳子

shots.section_title: 灌装不过头顶，不站凳子
shots.scene: 液滴溅向眼睛的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of drops splashing down from a high funnel toward a face with goggles, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀液一溅，正好落在脸上。

shots.section_title: 灌装不过头顶，不站凳子
shots.scene: 小研把滴定管降到视线以下，用小烧杯慢慢倒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the burette below eye level and pours slowly from a small beaker through the funnel.
shots.narration: 放低滴定管，用小烧杯慢慢倒。

shots.scene: 小研灌好后取下漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the funnel off the top of the burette after filling.
shots.narration: 灌好后，记得取下漏斗。

shots.scene: 漏斗残液滴进滴定管的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a funnel left on a burette dripping extra liquid inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 漏斗里的残液会滴下，读数就不准。

shots.section_title: 稀释浓酸：通风柜、酸入水
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里把浓酸缓缓倒进水中
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, slowly pours concentrated acid into a beaker of water inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 稀释浓酸，在通风柜里操作。
overlay: 稀释浓酸：通风柜、酸入水

shots.section_title: 稀释浓酸：通风柜、酸入水
shots.scene: 酸入水打勾，水入酸打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: acid poured into water with a green check, and water poured into acid crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 把酸慢慢加进水里，不能反过来。

shots.section_title: 稀释浓酸：通风柜、酸入水
shots.scene: 边加边用玻璃棒搅拌
shots.prompt_en: Acid is added slowly while a glass rod stirs the water. No people.
shots.narration: 边加边搅，让热量散开。

shots.scene: 试剂柜里酸和碱分放两格
shots.prompt_en: A reagent cabinet with acids on one shelf and bases on a separate shelf, labels blank. No people.
shots.narration: 酸和碱，分开存放。

shots.scene: 碱液装在带塑料盖的瓶里，磨口玻璃塞被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A base solution in a plastic bottle with a screw cap with a green check, and a glass stopper bottle crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 碱液用塑料瓶，别用磨口玻璃塞。

shots.scene: 瓶子上的空白标签被写满
shots.prompt_en: Blank labels on the bottles are being filled in with a pen. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶上标签写清名称和浓度。

shots.scene: 台面上一小摊液体，小研戴手套用吸附棉吸
shots.prompt_en: A small spill on the bench; the female graduate student wearing gloves covers it with absorbent pads.
shots.narration: 少量酸碱溅到台面，戴手套吸附。

shots.scene: 徒手擦拭液体的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand wiping a spill, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要徒手去擦。

shots.scene: 小研用湿布把台面擦净，吸附物放进废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench with a damp cloth and puts the used pads into a waste bag.
shots.narration: 清理干净，废料按规定收集。

shots.section_title: 溅到人身上：冲洗与报告
shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽用大量流水冲手臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his forearm under plenty of running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤，立即用大量流水冲洗。
overlay: 溅到人身上：冲洗与报告

shots.section_title: 溅到人身上：冲洗与报告
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.section_title: 溅到人身上：冲洗与报告
shots.scene: 小研扶着阿杰在洗眼器前冲眼
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student hold his eyes open under the eyewash.
shots.narration: 撑开眼皮，持续冲洗。

shots.section_title: 溅到人身上：冲洗与报告
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字，小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man; a telephone icon with a red cross floats beside them.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，及时就医，拨120。

shots.scene: 小研放出剩余碱液，用清水冲洗滴定管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drains the leftover base and rinses the burette with water.
shots.narration: 用完及时放掉碱液，洗净滴定管。

shots.scene: 旋塞被碱液粘住的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stopcock stuck fast with dried base, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 碱留在旋塞处，会把它粘死。

shots.scene: 滴定管倒置夹在架上晾干
shots.prompt_en: A clean burette clamped upside down on a stand to drain dry. No people.
shots.narration: 洗净后倒置晾干。

shots.scene: 小研把滴定后的溶液倒进废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the titrated solutions into a waste container with a blank label.
shots.narration: 滴定废液和剩余酸碱，按规定收集。

shots.scene: 倒入水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of acid or base poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要随手倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 王老师检查废液桶标签
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the blank label on the waste container with the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 如何处置，以本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现滴定管、旋塞、漏斗图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a burette, a stopcock and a funnel.
shots.narration: 先试漏，再润洗、排气泡。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套和放低的滴定管图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a burette lowered below eye level. No people.
shots.narration: 戴好防护，视线以下灌装。

shots.scene: 平视读数、粗滴、精滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eye level with a meniscus, a fast pouring burette and a single drop. No people.
shots.narration: 平视读数，先粗滴，再精滴。

shots.scene: 浅粉红锥形瓶和三张结果卡
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pale pink flask and three blank result cards. No people.
shots.narration: 粉红不褪是终点，三次取平均。

shots.scene: 洗眼器、清洗后的滴定管、废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station, a clean burette upside down and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 会应急，勤清洗，废液分类。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一瓶浅粉红溶液挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a flask of pale pink solution and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 一滴定乾坤，安全每一步，再见！
